license_required.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, shall practice optometry without a license.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the board of registration in optometry.

name.quote: "Board" means the board of registration in optometry.

type.quote: There shall be a board of registration in optometry consisting of 5 members; including 4 optometrists and one public member

age_minimum.quote: the person is over 18 years of age

degree_required.value: Minimum 2 years at a college of arts and sciences plus graduation from a 4-year school or college of optometry approved by the board
degree_required.quote: has completed a minimum of 2 years at a college of arts and sciences and has graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board, maintaining a minimum of 4 years in optometric training

accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board

exams.notes: General licensure examination approved by the board
exams.quote: the person has passed an examination approved by the board

exams.notes: Required for pharmaceutical agent certification; optometrists licensed after Jan 1, 1993 must pass; those licensed before must also complete a post-graduate course
exams.quote: shall pass an examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or its successor and approved by the board

exams.name: Board-approved glaucoma examination
exams.notes: Required for authorization to treat glaucoma
exams.quote: Optometrists shall pass an examination approved by the board that covers the educational components listed in subparagraph (a).

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under this chapter shall be renewed every two years

required.quote: All optometrists licensed in this state shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of optometry.

hours_per_period.quote: The length of study shall be prescribed by the board, with a minimum of 15 hours in a calendar year.

period_years.quote: a minimum of 15 hours in a calendar year

value: Subjects relating to the practice of optometry (general)
Minimum 50 hours/year for pharmaceutical-certified optometrists (minimum 20 hours formal courses, remainder independent study)
Minimum 10 hours glaucoma-specific education for glaucoma-certified optometrists (minimum 7 hours formal, 3 hours independent study)
topical_requirements.quote: An optometrist certified to use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry shall complete a minimum of 50 hours of continuing education every year in order to maintain pharmaceutical certification. A minimum of 20 hours shall be by participation in formal courses and the remainder by independent study.

is_mandatory.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, shall practice optometry without a license.

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or persons whomsoever to represent himself or themselves as an optometrist or optometrists unless qualified under the provisions of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, shall practice optometry without a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any unprofessional or dishonorable conduct unworthy of and affecting the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct, or dishonorable conduct unworthy of, and affecting the practice of, the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness or incompetency by reason of negligent habits or other causes; or negligent or willful acts inconsistent with patient health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unfitness or incompetency by reason of negligent habits or other causes; or negligent or willful acts performed in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under the care of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to alcohol or habit-forming drugs to a degree rendering the licensee unfit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Addiction to the use of alcohol or other habit-forming drugs to a degree which renders him unfit to practice under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incompetency to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incompetency to practice under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violation of the provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or repeated violation of the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of a similar license in another jurisdiction and not reinstated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a license, similar to one issued under this chapter, in another jurisdiction and not reinstated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any pharmaceutical agent not authorized under RSA 327:6-a or not described in RSA 327:1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any pharmaceutical agent by an optometrist not authorized under RSA 327:6-a or the use of any pharmaceutical agent other than those agents described in RSA 327:1 or those previously approved by the joint credentialing committee.

definition_quote.value: The employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids; diagnosis and treatment of any visual or muscular anomaly of the visual system; adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises; prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents; and application, prescribing, or removal of FDA-approved medical devices.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the: (a) Diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids.

value: Diagnosis and treatment of optical defects, deficiencies, deformities, or diseases of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids
Diagnosis and treatment of visual or muscular anomalies of the visual system
Adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises
Prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents
Application, prescribing, or removal of FDA-approved medical devices including contact lenses, plano lenses, and punctal plugs
Diagnosis of acute angle closure glaucoma and emergency care
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the: (a) Diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids. (b) Diagnosis and treatment of any visual or muscular anomaly of the visual system. (c) Adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises for the correction, relief or aid of the visual functions. (d) Prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents.

drug_authority.value: Licensed optometrists certified under RSA 327:6-a may use pharmaceutical agents including topical and oral agents; schedule I and II controlled substances are prohibited; schedule III and IV controlled substances may be used for analgesia if approved; anti-glaucoma agents authorized with glaucoma certification; vaccines authorized for adults.
drug_authority.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to permit an optometrist to administer any pharmaceutical product by injection; or to administer, prescribe or dispense any pharmaceutical product designated as a schedule I or schedule II controlled substance under RSA 318-B:1-a

surgery_prohibited.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery

surgery_definition.value: Any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical means, including use of lasers for therapeutic and photorefractive purposes, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound, or medication administered by injection; removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid is not considered surgery.
surgery_definition.quote: "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical means. Surgical procedures shall include the use of lasers for therapeutic and photorefractive purposes, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound, or medication administered by injection, provided that the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid shall not be considered a surgical procedure prohibited by this chapter.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid shall not be considered a surgical procedure prohibited by this chapter

value: Removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid
Application, prescribing, or removal of FDA-approved medical devices including contact lenses, plano lenses, and punctal plugs
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Application, prescribing, or removal of Food and Drug Administration approved medical devices, as approved by the board and consistent with the practice of optometry as set forth in this chapter, including, but not limited to, contact lenses, plano lenses, and punctal plugs.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: Anti-glaucoma agents provided that an optometrist may dispense or prescribe such agents if the optometrist has met the requirements of RSA 327:6-c.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: Diphenhydramine, epinephrine, or an equivalent medication administered by injection or other administration route to counter anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reaction.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises for the correction, relief or aid of the visual functions.

immunization_authority.quote: Vaccines by injection to individuals 18 years of age or older.

value: Schedule III and IV controlled substances may be used for analgesia if approved pursuant to RSA 327:6-a, VI and included in the formulary
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to permit an optometrist to administer any pharmaceutical product by injection; or to administer, prescribe or dispense any pharmaceutical product designated as a schedule I or schedule II controlled substance under RSA 318-B:1-a

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Antibiotics, sulfonomides, and combinations thereof, which are topically applied or orally administered to treat or alleviate the effects of disease or abnormal conditions of the human eye, adnexa, and eyelids, or structures posterior to the iris

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Only licensed optometrists who have successfully completed examinations on pharmacological substances and other treatments of diseases of the eye, adnexa and eyelids, who have met acceptable standards of education and professional competence as determined by the board, and who hold current certification in cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), shall be authorized to use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry.

tiered_license_types.quote: Upon certification to treat glaucoma patients pursuant to RSA 327:6-c, the office shall issue a license to the optometrist with a "tpa/g" certification.

specialty_certification_types.quote: Upon certification to treat glaucoma patients pursuant to RSA 327:6-c, the office shall issue a license to the optometrist with a "tpa/g" certification.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: an approved course shall be given by an accredited school or college of optometry in the United States and shall consist of a minimum of 105 hours, of which a minimum of 25 hours shall be in direct clinical training.

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: a minimum of 25 hours shall be in direct clinical training

referral_to_physician_required.quote: Upon such diagnosis, an optometrist may administer emergency care and shall immediately refer the patient to an ophthalmologist.

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: therapeutic pharmaceutical agent certified optometrists are required to provide evidence of successful collaborative treatment and co-management of 25 glaucoma patients

telemedicine_authorized.quote: Persons licensed by the office of professional licensure and certification shall be permitted to provide services through the use of telemedicine

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: Unless otherwise specified by the prescriber for health reasons, a contact lens prescription shall expire one year from the date of issue.
